Nadia Park: saw duplicate webhook deliveries this morning. root cause seems to be client replay during fastpath->slowpath handoff. can we formalize gateway behavior for mid-stream retries?
Omar Khan: yes. short trace:
```
CLIENT -> EDGE: POST /v1/webhook (chunked)
EDGE: fastpath route, then at t=6.1s demote to slowpath
UPSTREAM: 200 OK then TCP reset while flushing trailers
CLIENT: immediate retry same request, no Idempotency-Key
```
Meera Patel: problem: client-origin retries mid-stream can duplicate side effects. Proposal: gateway annotates retries it performs with headers and rejects unsafe client replays.
Ben Hsu: header names proposal: X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway|client|upstream, X-Edge-Retry-Id: <uuid>, X-Edge-Retry-TTL: <seconds>. Gateway sets these only for gateway-initiated resume/retry. lightweight and interoperable.
Omar Khan: policy sketch: 1) header-only retries (before body/commit) -> coalesce if same Idempotency-Key or same conn id. 2) mid-stream client replay without Idempotency-Key -> 409 Conflict with machine error code and header X-Edge-Retry-Allowed: false. 3) gateway-origin resume -> include X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway and X-Edge-Retry-Id plus TTL.
Nadia Park: example error response we should document:
```
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json
X-Edge-Retry-Allowed: false

{"error":"retry_requires_idempotency","docs":"https://docs.redwood.inference/edge/retries"}
```
Meera Patel: implementation notes: we cannot buffer arbitrary streams. Gateway-origin resume requires resumable tokens (offset+checkpoint) or small body buffering. Default X-Edge-Retry-TTL = 30s, configurable per-route. GC resume state after TTL and enforce per-route memory cap.
Ben Hsu: metrics/logging: emit edge.retry.origin.{gateway,client,upstream} and edge.retry.rejected_midstream_no_idempotency. Logs include retry_id when present.
ci-bot: merge queued: feature/edge-retry-headers (PR #4380) — tests passing :white_check_mark:
Omar Khan: follow-up RFC should include curl examples, SDK guidance (dont auto-retry streaming bodies; on 409 suggest adding Idempotency-Key), and unit/integration tests simulating fastpath->slowpath demotion.
Nadia Park: thanks, I'll write the RFC follow-up and attach small harness results. tagging eng/runtime and eng-platform for review. :pray:
